# removeTempKeys

common

fun [removeTempKeys](remove-temp-keys.html)()

Deletes the `temp:`-prefixed entries from [stateDelta](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/--root--.html) in place, so they are never persisted.

Unlike [removeStateByKey](remove-state-by-key.html), which marks a key with [State.REMOVED](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/-companion/-r-e-m-o-v-e-d.html), this drops the entries outright; the live session still receives `temp:` values via [State.applyTempDelta](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/apply-temp-delta.html).
